note: Manual head-coach corrections, applied over nflverse's schedule (games.csv home_coach/away_coach). nflverse lags on offseason hires and can be internally inconsistent — for 2026 it picked up Todd Monken to CLE but not Kevin Stefanski to ATL, still listing Raheem Morris. Entries here win. Each one is a liability: delete it once nflverse catches up, or it will silently override a correct value. Key is <season>:<team>.
